calculation_handling.description: Minimum driveway width to a loading space depends on one-way or two-way use, which is not a lot condition.
calculation_handling.gaps: No token or input distinguishes a one-way from a two-way driveway.

units.disclosure: The minimum width of a driveway to a loading space (3.5 metres one-way, 6.0 metres two-way) is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum vertical clearance to a loading space depends on the loading space Type, which is not a lot condition.
calculation_handling.gaps: No input gives the Type of loading space.

units.disclosure: The minimum vertical clearance along a driveway to a loading space (4.4, 4.0 or 3.0 metres by Type) is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Maximum driveway slope has no DSL target.
calculation_handling.gaps: No slope target exists in the vocabulary.

units.disclosure: The maximum slope (8%) of a driveway leading to a Type G loading space is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Maximum driveway slope has no DSL target.
calculation_handling.gaps: No slope target exists in the vocabulary.

units.disclosure: The maximum slope (15%) of a driveway leading to any other loading space is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum width 5.5 m of a two-way vehicle entrance and exit to a building with a loading space.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only when a loading space is inside a building and the driveway is two-way; neither is held.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum width 3.5 m of a one-way vehicle entrance or exit that is 6.0 m or more from the street lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only for a loading space inside a building, a one-way driveway and an entrance at least 6.0 m from the lot line; none is held.

220.5.20.1(1).explanation: A driveway to a loading space must be at least 3.5 metres wide if one-way or 6.0 metres if two-way, with a vertical clearance of at least 4.4 metres to a Type A or G space, 4.0 metres to Type B and 3.0 metres to Type C.

220.5.20.1(2).explanation: A driveway leading to a loading space may slope at most 8% for a Type G space and 15% otherwise.

220.5.20.1(3).explanation: If a loading space is inside a building, a two-way vehicle entrance and exit must be at least 5.5 metres wide, and a one-way entrance or exit at least 3.5 metres wide when it is 6.0 metres or more from the street lot line.
